package.name: so101_safety
package.description: SO-101 safety subsystem: perception-driven protective-stop triggers (depth_safety_monitor for monocular-depth proximity, person_safety_monitor for detection-based presence) and their shared enforcement nodes (trajectory_safety_gate for the JointTrajectory/JTC path, safety_pause_bridge for the MoveIt Servo path). Decoupled from so101_depth_demo / so101_yolo_demo -- the monitor nodes consume an already-published perception topic rather than running their own model inference, so this package has no ONNX/OpenCV dependencies. Intended as the home for future safety behaviours (diagnostics, watchdogs, ...).
